If a relative or legal guardian is traveling into Colombia with the child, that relative or legal guardian may be required to present a notarized consent of travel signed by both parents and a copy of both parents' ID. If only one parent is traveling into Colombia with the child, that parent may be required to present a notarized consent of travel signed by the other parent. If a relative or legal guardian is traveling into Colombia with the child, that relative or legal guardian may be required to present a notarized consent of travel signed by both parents and a copy of both parents' ID. If only one parent is traveling into Colombia with the child, that parent may be required to present a notarized consent of travel signed by the other parent. paragraphs: Elektra Sanatorium is located in Molodezhny. The hotel is located on the banks of the Angara River, twenty kilometers from Lake Baikal. The complex is located away from the noisy city and resort villages, at 43 kilometers of the Baikal Highway. Nearby are the ethnographic museum Taltsy and the Baikal Museum of Flora and Fauna. Irkutsk airport is 39 km away, the city center is 43 km away.
description_struct.title: Location

paragraphs: Located in a pine forest, the sanatorium occupies a landscaped closed area of more than twenty hectares and consists of several residential buildings and cottages.

Vacationers can enjoy buffet meals; there is also a cafe and a herbal bar. Guests have at their disposal two swimming pools - year-round indoor, and seasonally open - outdoor, a bath complex with a hammam, a gym with aerobics instructors, secure parking, wireless Internet, sports grounds, a tennis court, billiards, a shooting range, and table tennis. In the evenings, vacationers can enjoy film screenings, concerts and animation programs. For children, on the territory of the health resort there is a playground with inflatable attractions and a playroom, there are teachers and animators, and rental of chairs, children's bicycles, skates and skis is available. There is a private beach 300 meters away on the banks of the Angara. The sand and pebble beach is equipped with sun loungers, sun loungers, and a bar.

The multidisciplinary sanatorium offers vacationers various types of spa treatment, as well as a large selection of wellness programs. The health resort uses natural treatment factors, for example, Electra mineral water extracted from its own well, sulfide-silt mud brought from deposits near the city of Kislovodsk, mineral brine for the pool from a salt lake. At the same time, all vacationers have access to such traditional treatment methods as mud therapy, balneotherapy, hardware physiotherapy, exercise therapy, and thermotherapy in the spa center.

Free services are provided: doctor's appointment and observation, herbal medicine, oxygen cocktail, drinking medicinal mineral water from the Electra well, gym classes with an instructor, Nordic walking classes, Wi-Fi.

The sanatorium has a children's health center Malysh, in which special treatment programs have been developed for children aged 3 to 12 years, separately from adults, taking into account the age and characteristics of the body.

U morya stolovaya, restoranyi s zhivoj muzyikoj i kafe s domashnej kuhnej. Magazinyi s neprodovol'stvennyimi tovarami. 
Dom okruzhayut zhivopisnyie vidyi na goryi Ayu-Dag i Aj-Petri, lavandovoe pole i pole iz makov. Utrom vstrechaet krasivyij rassvet.
Dorogie gosti radyi videt' Vas u nas v gostyah
Glavnoe pravilo - uvazhenie k ostal'nyim. Esli vyi lyubite muzyiku, ne vklyuchajte ee gromko i vyiklyuchajte sovsem posle 11 vechera. Myi ochen' vnimatel'no otnosimsya k chistote v dome. Poetomu, esli vyi s zhivotnyimi, myi, k sozhaleniyu, ne smozhem vas zaselit'. S soboj vyi mozhete prinosit' lyubuyu edu.

Zaezd v dom vozmozhen v lyuboe vremya po predvaritel'noj dogovorennosti. Vyiezd - analogichno, v udobnoe vam vremya (do 12 chasov dnya den' vyiezda ne vhodit v stoimost' prozhivaniya).
U vas v rasporyazhenii est' vsya infrastruktura doma: tualetyi, dushevyie, gostevaya kuhnya, mesta dlya otdyiha vo dvore i na verande, mangal, shampuryi.
Wi-fi
Vo vsem dome rabotaet besplatnaya set'.

Kuhnya
U nas mozhno prigotovit' edu, esli vyi predpochitaete gotovit' sami

Transfer i ekskursii
Myi pomozhem organizovat' transfer iz Simferopolya ili Kerchi ili ustroit' vam personal'nuyu ekskursiyu

Televidenie
V vseh nomerah est' sobstvennyie televizoryi

Spokojnyij son
Dom nahoditsya daleko ot shumnyih diskotek i restoranov. Vyi i vashi deti smogut otlichno vyispat'sya
